tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang dang rang gi slob ma rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer dang bsam gtan rgya mtsho chos skyong la gtad pa'i bcad rgya byas dus gtor dar la bris pa'i yi ge yin// dpal mgon po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis byams snying rje dang ldan pas sems can gyi don du/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi mgon po bsten ma bsten pas sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du mgon po la gtad snyam du bsam pa lags pas/ dus da nas bzung nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ bdag dang slob ma rab 'byams smra ba bsod nams 'od zer dang / bsam gtan rgya mtsho sogs 'di dag nag po chen po khyed la gtad pa yin pas/ bdag dang slob ma ming 'di zhes bya ba dus 'dir yid la re ba bzhin tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam pa thams cad 'grub nas/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gi skye gnas bzhi khams gsum rigs drug gar skyes kyang las bsags pa yod kyang / khyed ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan zhing / rdzu 'phrul dang mthu stobs mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag dang slob ma 'di dag bdud dang / sdig pa'i grogs dang / dgra 'dre la sogs pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa'i dbang du ma gtong bar srungs shig las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad srungs shig chos byed pa'i mthun rkyen sgrubs shig 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi nas bdag dang slob ma 'di dag lhan cig 'bral ba med par bde ba can du skye bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas bdag dang slob ma 'di dag gi sprul pa yang sprul du mas sa skya pa'i bstan pa dkar 'byams du bya nus par mdzod cig thub pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs nas dam bcas pa'i thugs dam las ma g.yol cig dge zhing bkra shis/ /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o//
